title: Pumpkin Spice Protein Overnight Oats
ingredients: 1/3 cup pumpkin puree (100% pure canned pumpkin, not pumpkin pie mix)
1/3 cup Forager Project Organic Dairy-Free Greek-Style Yogurt (Unsweetened Plain or Vanilla)
1/2 cup unsweetened almond milk, oat milk, or water
1 scoop (approx. 20-30g) unflavored or vanilla pea protein powder
1 tbsp chia seeds or ground flaxseed (helps thicken and absorb liquid)
1 tbsp maple syrup (adjust to taste, especially if using unflavored protein)
1 tsp pumpkin pie spice (or 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ginger, pinch of nutmeg & clove)
Pinch of salt (enhances sweetness and cuts pea protein earthy notes)
instructions: Whisk the wet ingredients & protein: In a 16 oz mason jar or container, whisk together the pumpkin puree, Forager Greek yogurt, plant milk, maple syrup, vanilla, pumpkin pie spice, salt, and pea protein powder until completely smooth. Tip: whisking pea protein with the liquid ingredients first prevents clumps and ensures a creamy texture.
Fold in oats & seeds: Add the rolled oats and chia/flax seeds. Stir thoroughly with a spoon, ensuring no dry oats remain at the bottom.
Refrigerate: Seal with a lid and place in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight (8 hours).
Serve: Stir well before eating. If the mixture is too thick, splash in 1-2 tablespoons of additional plant milk to reach your preferred consistency.
notes: Micronutrients: Vitamin A >200% DV (pumpkin), Iron ~35-40% DV (oats, pumpkin, chia, pea protein), Calcium & Potassium ~15-20% DV. Fiber covers nearly 50% of daily recommended intake. Values calculated using 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1/3 cup pumpkin puree, 1/3 cup Forager Unsweetened Plain Greek-style yogurt, 1 scoop (25g) unflavored pea protein isolate, 1 tbsp chia seeds, 1 tbsp maple syrup, 1/2 cup unsweetened almond milk. Sweetened/vanilla-flavored swaps shift calories and sugar slightly.
